description.en: Personal plugin market for the DeepSeek Harness: install plugins straight from GitHub repositories.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的个人插件市场：直接从 GitHub 仓库安装插件。

description.en: Adds a Skills section right below Models in the settings page: browse and manage every skill the Harness has loaded (global ~/.dsh/skills, user-level ~/.agents/skills, and each workspace's .dsh/skills / .agents/skills), with scope switching, search, Markdown details, enable/disable, import, delete and open-folder.
description.zh: 在设置页「模型」正下方新增「技能」分区：集中展示并管理当前加载到的全部技能（全局 ~/.dsh/skills、用户级 ~/.agents/skills，以及各工作区的 .dsh/skills 与 .agents/skills），支持作用域切换、搜索、Markdown 详情、启停、导入、删除与打开目录。
